build_ConvOneHotCoach: build a ConvOneHotCoach model with args, max_raw_chars, max_instruction_span, and num_resource_bin parameters
load_ConvOneHotCoach: load a pretrained ConvOneHotCoach model from a saved model file using the load class method
compute_loss: compute the training loss for a batch combining continuation and language instruction losses
rl_forward: run the RL forward pass on a batch to get continuation probability, instruction probability, and value
format_rl_language_input: format RL language input by parsing previous instruction indices into one-hot format
